course.title: Tailwind CSS — Complete Practical Course
course.description: A practical Tailwind CSS course covering utility-first styling, responsive layouts, typography, components, learning-platform UI, advanced customization, React/Next.js integration, accessibility and production projects.
learningOutcomes: Use Flexbox and Grid with Tailwind.
Use dark mode and theme tokens.
Integrate Tailwind with React and Next.js.
